plugins.name: agent-comms
plugins.description: Main/subagent real-time comms for ZCode: bundled worker agent type with a three-boundary reporting protocol, plus report/wait_worker_event/read_events MCP tools (wait-any-worker, silence detection, auditable anchor artifacts).

description_i18n.en: Real-time main/subagent communication: bundled worker type with reporting protocol baked into its system prompt, plus wait-any-worker MCP tool with timeout summaries.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 主/子代理实时互通：worker 类型自带三层边界汇报协议（随系统提示词注入），配套 report/wait_worker_event/read_events 工具实现任意 worker 聚合等待、沉默检测与锚工件审计。

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode: forces the simplest, shortest solution that actually works - YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions. Packaged from DietrichGebert/ponytail v4.9.0 (skills only).

description_i18n.en: Lazy senior dev mode: forces the simplest, shortest solution that actually works - YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions. Packaged from DietrichGebert/ponytail v4.9.0 (skills only).
description_i18n.zh-CN: 「懒惰资深程序员」模式：写代码前先走懒惰阶梯（YAGNI → 代码库已有 → 标准库 → 平台原生 → 已装依赖 → 一行搞定 → 最小可用实现），拒绝过度设计与无谓抽象，但不牺牲安全、校验与无障碍。含主模式（三档强度）、diff 过度设计审查、全仓库审计、简化债务台账、收益看板、帮助卡片共 6 个技能。打包自 DietrichGebert/ponytail v4.9.0。
